uncertainty_caveat: Percentile 95% intervals on fixed OOF predictions: resample whole metros for fixed-roster count metrics; additionally independently resample company and metro clusters for B count and probability metrics. No independent-Bernoulli intervals. These intervals omit model-refitting and selection uncertainty.
atlanta_band_caveat: Heuristic 90% empirical prediction band: final expected count plus/minus the finite-sample-adjusted 90th percentile of absolute development OOF count residuals, lower bound truncated at zero. Not a formal conformal interval or a confidence interval for the expected count.
